dc:description: One outcome × primary/continuing population × supported degree-field group × completion-period bin × category.
dc:title: Content observed
notes: All cells are described as lexical strings to preserve source decimal precision and codes. Parse measures using units and status fields.

A blank CSV cell alone does not identify missingness: valid blank keys, structurally inapplicable fields and unavailable values are distinguished by the dataset contract, status columns and companion JSON.
Source units and values are unchanged; the interface converts probabilities to percentages only for display.

Field bindings: outcome: count.outcome; population: count.population; group_id: count.group_id; degree_group: count.degree_group; field_code: count.field_code; period: count.period; category: count.category; value: 100*count.selected_works/count.eligible_works; numerator: count.selected_works; denominator: count.eligible_works; eligible_institutions: count.eligible_institutions; nonexclusive: count.nonexclusive; support_status: count.report_supported; unavailable_reason: count.unavailable_reason
Reuse terms remain source-specific; see the dataset manifest and released access notices.
